text: The Weapon Assembly Station is a utility found within the Call of Duty: WWII Zombies map The Final Reich. It is an automated crafting station located within the Command Room of the bunker, which is utilized to create the Tesla Gun and its variants with the use of the Geistkraft Transfer Device.
Weapon Perks are feature that first appeared within the Nazi Zombies mode of Call of Duty: WWII before reappearing in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Waffenbox is a utility featured in Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies, found in The Tortured Path. It replaces both the Mystery Box and the Weapon Lockers from the previous maps. As revealed by the Notebook, the creator of the Waffenbox is Heinz Richter.

The Weapon Drop is a Field Upgrade featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is sends an airdrop to the location marked with a Smoke Grenade. The drop can give the player and teammates either an attachment to their current weapon or a customized weapon. The attachment is equipped regardless of the amount of attachments already on the player's weapon, and the customized gun replaces the gun currently held. It should be noted that with the weapon drop box, a player with 5 attachments on their weapon can add 3 more attachments, up to 8 total, using the box. However, the attachments are random, thus resulting in a mixed weapon, that can either be made better, or worse, or mediocre. It is also available in Call of Duty: Warzone in Plunder game mode.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.
The is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

War Tracks (initially called Vehicle Tracks) are a vehicle customization feature introduced in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone as part of the Season Five update. War Tracks are exclusively earned through the progression of Battle Passes in the game. Only one Wartrack Pack or Mixtape can be applied to a vehicle at any given time. As of mid-season update of the Season One in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, selected tracks from previous games' soundtracks can be used in Cold War Music Player.

The Welding Gun is a tool featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It is available in the Tank Battle and Ground War: Skirmish game modes of Battle Royale, and is used for repairing tanks and depots. It can also be used for killing enemies at close range.
The is a submachine gun that was added to Call of Duty: Vanguard on January 11th, 2022 as part of the Season One update.
The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It was added as part of the Season Two update.
The Weapon Trade Station is a utility featured in Call of Duty: Warzone and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
The Weapon Case is an item featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and Call of Duty: Mobile.

White Star Awakens (Proton - ν Gundam Battle Theme) is the third track of the Call of Duty: Mobile Gundams Arrive Version (Original Game Soundtrack). It is composed by Tencent Games and [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm8906154 Kazuki Higashihara], with a runtime of 1:34.
Warzone Training is a game mode featured in Call of Duty: Warzone. It was a solo only training mode designed for players to get a grasp at the controls and mechanics of the game.
The Warden 308 is a marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
The Warden's Blight is a wonder weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies in the map Rex Infernus.
The Weevil is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Heroes. It is reminiscent of the P90 from past installments.
War Sword is the fifth track of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II Season 2 (Official Game Soundtrack). It is composed by , with a runtime of 3:16.

The Woodland Camouflage is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.
Yukon is a type of weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Black Ops.

The is a light machine gun found in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). It is an allied Light Machine Gun with a 100 round magazine and an automatic fire mode. It has somewhat obstructive iron-sights and very high and uncontrollable recoil (which can be remedied by using the perk Nerves of Steel), along with a slow rate of fire, but these aspects are countered by a decent amount of damage, killing an enemy with two hits even at longer ranges. In multiplayer it is pre-unlocked for the allied faction and 150 kills with it will unlock the M60. In Zombie mode, the XM22 can also be found in the Mystery Box or bought from the wall in the third room of all maps for 4000 points.

The was the main Soviet fighter aircraft used in World War II by the Soviet Air Force. It was the first Soviet fighter plane capable of going toe-to-toe with the German Luftwaffe's BF109. The Yak-9 can be seen in Call of Duty: World at War and Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

Winter is a weapon Camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. It is only available to Founder members on Call of Duty ELITE and became available on November 13, 2011. It cannot be used offline. On the Wii, it is unlocked after prestiging once, as the Wii cannot connect to ELITE. As the ELITE service shut down, the Winter camouflage and Marine Camouflage aren't accessable through standard means.
Yankee Camouflage was a weapon camouflage skin planned to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, but was cut from the final version of the game.
The XPR-50 (called AS50 in the game files) is a sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team, Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile.

The Y-8 is a medium sized transport aircraft featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It is seen several times during the campaign, but its most prominent appearance was in All or Nothing, where it was converted into a gunship and used by the Federation to attack the U.S.S. Liberator.
The X08 Selva Tigre (lit. Jungle Tiger) is a Main Battle Tank that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts.
Wristblades are a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. They are a one-hit kill melee weapon used with the Predator Field Order on the map Ruins.

The XMG (referred to as EXO245 Autocannon in the Atlas Advanced Soldier Manual and in concept art) is a dual-wielded heavy weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare; it is only available in multiplayer and Exo Survival.

The XS1 Goliath, also known as the AST, Goliath armor, and ATLAS Goliath, is a manually-piloted mechanized suit of advanced armor that appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Heroes and Call of Duty: Mobile.

X-Ray Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is available with the purchase of the X-Ray Pack. The camouflage turns the majority of the weapon into a translucent blue material. X-Ray Personalization Pack AW.jpeg|The X-Ray Pack poster.
The XM-53 is a rocket launcher featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III and is a cut weapon from Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.
The XR-2 is a bullpup three-round burst assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. It is one of the few burst-fire weapons that continuously shoot bursts while holding down the trigger.

The Wrench is a melee weapon briefly seen in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, and available for use in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered and Call of Duty: Mobile. It also also available for use in the War Mode of Call of Duty: WWII.

Colonel Young Kim is a minor antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef carrier Cerberus. Kim is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Phoenix.

Captain Yenal Kal is an antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and a member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef carrier Centauri. Kal is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Trace Kill.
Winter Tiger Camouflage is a type of weapon camouflage skin that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

The X-Eon (known as VR-AR46 in pre-release) is a fully-automatic energy assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare that was added in the March 28th, 2017 update. It appears to be a highly futuristic weapon, offering abilities such as tight hip spread, increased fire rate when aiming down sights, along with a tracker like sight that comes by default. It is available for free for Season Pass holders, otherwise it can be unlocked via a challenge or a Supply Drop. However, bots will sometimes wield this weapon
The X51 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online.

The Wunderbuss is a geistkraft weapon that appears in the Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies map The Shadowed Throne. The weapon appears to be a modified blunderbuss configured with advanced Geistkraft circuitry and customization.
Wild Fire is an Operator Mod exclusive to the Spitfire submachine gun in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. It dramatically increases fire rate at the cost of worsened accuracy.
The Wz. 35 is a bolt-action sniper rifle was added to Call of Duty: WWII with the 1.24 patch update on June 4th, 2019.
The Wimmersperg Spz is an automatic rifle featured in Call of Duty: WWII. It was added via an update on July 23rd, 2019.
The XRK SA87 Heavy Stock Pro is an attachment for the SA87 bullpup light machine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

XRK (Xecutive Response Kartel), sometimes known as "XRK Rifleworks", is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. Their logo is simply their name XRK in stylized all caps lettering.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Mobile.
The XRK Tank Brake is a muzzle attachment for the Rytec AMR in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.
The XRK Thunder 200 Lb is an attachment for the Crossbow Marksman Rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, classed under the exclusive Arms attachment category.
The XRK Quill 100 Lb is an attachment for the Crossbow Marksman Rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, classed under the exclusive Arms attachment category.
The XRK Carbon Elite is an attachment for the Crossbow Marksman Rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, classed under the exclusive Arms attachment category.
The YKM Standard is a barrel attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It is exclusive to the Locus sniper rifle.
The XRK Ultralight is a Barrel-class attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is exclusive to the Holger-26 Light Machine Gun.

Wild Hip Fire is a Weapon Perk featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, available to most submachine guns (excluding the FSS Hurricane and Static-HV), as well as the Groza assault rifle and the L-CAR 9 pistol.
XTEN is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

The [https://www.thefirearmblog.com/blog/2021/06/24/tfb-review-cadex-cdx-50-tremor/ XRK Stalker] is a sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was added as part of the Season One update.

The Willis 3x is a recon optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for all weapon classes, excluding Pistols.
The XR-3 Ion is a bullpup sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
The X9 Maverick is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
The X52 Resonator is a special weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It was added on October 16th, 2025 as part of the Season Six update.
The XM325 is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

The XM108 SEAR was an assault rifle that was featured in Call of Duty: Future Warfare. However, when Future Warfare was canceled, the XM108 SEAR was discarded as well, and was never ported to any other future titles.
The Wunderbarrage Controller is a craftable support and Wonder Weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies. It is only available in the map Totenreich.

refers to how a tower attacks. Each attack type is distinguished by the type of said weapon, such as sharp darts or explosive bombs. Some attacks don't fit into any of the categories. These are listed as Other. Attack types incorporate damage types as part of the formula. In addition, every type of attack possesses a specific amount of the four basic statistics (pierce, range, attack speed, and damage) plus other statistics. Some of these miscellaneous statistics of certain attacks may include: * Projectile speed * Projectile lifespan * Blast/splash radius (e.g. Bomb Shooter explosions, Alchemist splashes, Tech Terror annihilation blast) * Cooldown timer (e.g. Sticky Bomb timer, Gwendolin's Heat It Up minimum cooldown timer, Druid of the Jungle's vines versus strong bloons) * Deployment cooldown (e.g. BTD6 Ground Zero drop time) * Homing curve (e.g. Guided Magic bolts, Neva-Miss Targeting darts) * Ability duration * Ability cooldown

Aircraft Carrier is the final upgrade of path 1 for the Monkey Buccaneer in Bloons TD 5. It costs $12750 on Easy, $15000 on Medium, $16200 on Hard and $18000 on Impoppable. Its description says that it rapidly launches Monkey Ace pilots that strafe the area with darts. The Aircraft Carrier launches three mini aces that keep on landing and taking off on the Aircraft Carrier. The Monkey Aces can fire in all directions. The Monkey Aces always fly in an O shape and are small. Unlike the usual Monkey Aces, each plane shoots two fast streams of darts from its front each as powerful as a non-upgraded Super Monkey (0/0). These mini Aces also regularly shoot 8 darts in different directions like a Tack Shooter. In BTD6, this upgrade returns. See more on this page.

The Anti-Materials Gun Lab is required to allow research of the Cripple MOAB upgrade. It costs 20,000 to buy, takes 36 hours to construct and gives 500 XP when construction is completed. It consumes 40 and takes up a 1x1 square. Level 18 is required to unlock.
The Antimatter Weapon Facility is a Special Building that is required for the Technological Terror upgrade.

4D Sword is an Epic weapon in Bloons Adventure Time TD. It has a special property to slow bloons (including MOABs) on contact and completely destroy them with 5% chance, with a cooldown of 7 seconds. It can only be equipped by Finn, Warrior Bubblegum and Dungeon Finn.
Acoustic Guitar is an Uncommon Instrument weapon that gives 2 range +0.25 per star to the holder and +1 range to all towers in range.

is an Instrument Weapon that gives 1 damage + 1 per 5 stars and gives characters in range + 5% attack speed and Marceline's allies and skeletons get + 5 range and + 10% attack speed. It can only be equipped to Marceline.
The Abracadaniel's Wand is a Super Rare Wand Weapon in Bloons Adventure Time TD. It can only be equipped to Flame Princess, Ice King, or Sam.

Armor Piercing Darts is the 4th upgrade on Path 3 of the Monkey Sub in Bloons TD Battles 2. Each main dart deals 3 damage and 5 MOAB-class damage. Upon impact, the airburst darts split, each hitting up to 5 bloons (8 with Barbed Darts) and dealing 1 damage and 2 MOAB-class damage. It costs $3200, and is unlocked with purchase of Monkey Sub.

Its functionality is unknown, but more likely than not it would have increased the damage your monkeys would deal against MOAB class bloons. It was found in the game's files. Because of the lack of a correlating VFX file, along with the trend of every other powerup featuring a dart, this powerup more than likely would be constantly active.

Archer's Instinct is an Exotic Power Card. Players do not unlock this card by default, and must craft it. It costs 3500 Exotic Power Tokens to unlock, up to 3 cards. It costs 2 Gold, is Super Rare rarity, has 2 charges, and does not have the Unique property. When used, the 3 cards from the user's deck appear. The player must choose one card and add it to their hand, while other cards go to the bottom of the deck.

BB Gatling Gun is an Artifact in Bloons TD 6 for the Rogue Legends DLC. With this Artifact active, all Monkeys projectiles deviate in a random angle between ±30° from their intended target, similar to the Dartling Gunner. As a trade off, the attack speed will be faster depending the Rarity of the Artifact. This artifact also overrides the full accuracy of Hawk's Eye Artifact. Obyn Greenfoot starts with this artifact as his starting kit, as Rare Rarity.

The Blade Shooter is the third upgrade of the Tack Shooter. Instead of the tower shooting tacks, it shoots larger razor blades with more accuracy. This upgrade will also pop more bloons and shoot faster. In BTD3, the upgrade is the second upgrade for the first path. In BTD4, it is the third upgrade for the Tack Shooter. In BTD5, the Blade Shooter is the third upgrade of path 2. According to the in-game description, it shoots blades in all directions. Each blade pops up to 2 bloons per shot, 3 in BTDB Mobile. It costs $680 on Medium. In BTDB Mobile, it costs $600.

Blade Maelstrom is the fourth and final upgrade on the second path of the Tack Shooter in BTD5. It is unlocked upon reaching Rank 20. It is the special ability for the Tack Shooter in BTD5, BTD Battles and BMC. When activated, the Blade Maelstrom rapidly shoots two streams of blades, which spiral outwards. Its ability cooldown only lasts for 20 seconds. In BTD5, the ability spews out 120 blades (60 for each of the two spirals). It takes 2 seconds for the whole attack to start and end, letting out 60 blades per second. It costs $2295 on Easy, $2700 on Medium and $2915, Hard and $3240 on Impoppable. In BTDB Mobile, it costs $2800.

The Blademill is a Special Building that allows research of the Blade Maelstrom upgrade for the Tack Shooter, it costs 14,000 to build, it takes 48 hours to construct and gives 500XP when construction is finished. It consumes 40 and a 1x1 tile space. It requires Level 18 to unlock.

Black Bow Tie is a Rare Trinket in Bloons Adventure Time TD. It can only be equipped to male characters (such as Finn, Max, or Jake), but if a female character is in range of the equipped character, he gains 15% bonus attack speed and 6 extra range. It can be obtained from a Rare Wish Orb, or occasionally from a Super Rare Wish Orb or an Uncommon Wish Orb. It can be sharded for 100 Shards.

The Blessed Dart is an Epic Weapon. It has a chance of instakilling bloons up to Ceramics. As Blessed Dart is a Dart weapon, it can only be equipped to Max, Juggernaut Max, Sai, Commander Cassie, Supermonkey, and Hunter Marceline.
The Ball Blam Burglerber is an Epic Weapon in Bloons Adventure Time TD only usable by Princess Bubblegum.

It grants a shield equal to 100 + Player Level, absorbing up to that many Red Bloon Equivalents before you lose any lives. The shield reaches its maximum capacity of 200 at level 100. Once the shield is depleted, it enters a 5-minute cooldown before it can be activated again.

Banana Monkey is a purchasable monkey "decoration" in Bloons Pop!. He is a mascot monkey who wears a banana suit. Banana Suit is available in the location "Banana Farm" under the Build menu. It costs 5 and 50 to unlock. This small monkey wears a banana suit, and dances from side to side. When tapped, the monkey falls down and makes a cute grunt, before getting up again. Banana Monkey is also a Banana Farmer cosmetic skin in Bloons TD 6, purchasable for 100 Trophies in the Trophy Store.

Blade Sauda Nowhere is a Tutorial Quest in Bloons TD 6, added in Version 37.0. It requires Level 20 to unlock. Upon completing the quest, the rewards are two Time Stops, two MOAB Mines, and two Glue Traps. __TOC__

The Big Airship of Doom, abbreviated as BAD, is a high-health blimp much stronger than the Zeppelin of Mighty Gargantuaness. First debuted in Bloons TD 6, it is the strongest multi-HP bloon throughout the series excluding Boss Bloons, and is among the highest ranking MOAB-class bloons in the franchise, alongside Boss Bloons. The BAD naturally has 20,000 health (28,000 upon first encounter round in BTD6) and will release 2 ZOMGs and 3 DDTs once popped. In Bloons TD 6, the BAD moves at 0.18x the speed of a Red Bloon, a Lead Bloon, or a MOAB, just as slow as a ZOMG. As with all MOAB-class bloons, the BAD can be greatly damaged by attacks that inflict extra damage to MOAB-class bloons compared to normal bloons. The BAD is also much larger than any other MOAB-class bloon in games it appears, although smaller in Bloons Adventure Time TD, and therefore a BAD is even easier to be hit by multi-projectile attacks such as Tack Sprayer. Unlike weaker MOAB-class bloons, the BAD is fully immune to all forms of movement hinderances and almost all instakills. In BTD6 and BTD Battles 2, both after updates, BADs can be affected by specialized sources of extra damage to BADs, unlike almost all MOAB-class bloons. (BTD6 had the damage type removed in update 49.0) BADs are capable of gaining extra health. In all BTD6 Generation games, the BAD can become a Fortified BAD, as the fortification layer gives it and its descendants with double health; in BTD6, a Fortified BAD has 40,000 health for the BA

Bloon Embiggen is an Basic Power Card. Players do not unlock this card by default, and must craft it. It costs 800 Basic Power Tokens to unlock, up to 3 cards. It costs 4 Gold, is Rare rarity, and does not have the Unique property. When played, it grants all friendly Bloons with +25 HP.

Bloon Reinforcements! is an Advanced Power Card. Players do not unlock this card by default, and must craft it. It costs 1500 Basic Power Tokens to unlock, up to 3 cards. It costs 3 Gold, is Rare rarity, and does not have the Unique property. When drawed, draw 2 Basic Bloon cards from your deck.

Business Men (for more information, see Business Men) is a Common ally in Bloons Adventure Time TD that costs $380 to place. They use their trusty axe to slice the bloons coming their way. They can be obtained through the common wish orb. They can be sharded for 10 shards. A maximum of 4 Business Men (or more with ally increasing upgrades) can be placed per slot.

Bomba is a Super Rare weapon in Bloons Adventure Time TD. It is a Bomb counterpart to Cybernetic Arrow. As it is a bomb weapon, it can be equipped to C4 Charlie and Captain Cassie.
Bouncy Shots is a constant 2-star powerup in Bloons Supermonkey 2 Mobile. It allows weapon projectiles to bounce off the sides of the screen.

Bloontonium Cache is a Basic Power Card. Players do not unlock this card by default, and must craft it. It costs 300 Basic Power Tokens to unlock, up to 3 cards. It costs 0 Gold, is Common rarity, and does not have the Unique property. When played, gain 5 Bloontonium to the player's hero.

is the fourth upgrade of Path 2 for the Desperado in Bloons TD 6. It gains the Marked to Pop ability and improves its Take Aim ability buff. The rifle also deals 24 damage, +24 to Fortified, while the pistol does 16 damage and +16 Ceramic damage. In addition, the Desperado will mark a Bloon in range every 9 seconds up to 3 with a marked status. All Desperadoes will gain Marked Prioritization if at least one Bounty Hunter (or above) is present. Marked to Pop ability makes Desperado briefly stop attacking, and then marking up to 10 bloons (at a rate of 0.2 seconds per mark), which causes all Desperados to deal an extra +100% damage and grant +100% cash per pop to them. Then, the Bounty Hunter itself rapidly attacks at marked bloons at a rate of every 0.05s with infinite range, dealing 30 damage (120 on crit) with 1 unbuffable pierce. Marked Bloons only affect the current layer and last infinitely. The ability has a cooldown of 45 seconds. Take Aim now grants +50% range in addition to 50% reduced projectile spread with camo detection and targeted tower gain Black, White, Zebra, and Purple Popping Power for 15 seconds. The ability cooldown remains 30 seconds. Take Aim from the T4 and above cannot stack with the T3, but does take priority while active.

The Bloontonium Storage Tank is a building in Bloons Monkey City. Each one costs $1000, occupies one square and stores 1000 for use in Monkey vs Monkey battles. They cost 1000, take 20 minutes to build and give 500 XP once construction is completed. Level 8 is required to unlock (although Level 9 is required for Monkey vs Monkey). They cannot be upgraded, so the only way to increase your Bloontonium capacity further is to build more of them. These buildings do not appear in the mobile version, as they are replaced by one single 2x2 building called the Bloon Inflation Factory.

Crash Site is a Special Mission that involves saving a Heli Pilot from bloons. This mission is very similar to the Submarine Alliance mission: Same as the Broken 2/4 Sub, the broken Heli Pilot is at the middle. Paths go towards the Heli Pilot in 2 paths. You can either defend the Heli Pilot or repair it to use as a free tower. Repairing costs $1000, so players can pretty much get it on the first round. The highest bloon rank is the Ceramic Bloon and there are 17 rounds.
Candycorn Spear is a common trinket in Bloons Adventure Time TD.
The Cla Blade is a Rare Trinket in Bloons Adventure Time TD. It has some character restrictions, letting any character equip it except Ice King.
The Candy Dive Suit is an Epic Trinket in Bloons Adventure Time TD. It has no character restrictions, letting any character equip it.

Candy Cane Shotgun is a Super Rare Weapon. It allows the equipped character to shoot three projectiles instead of one, along with +1 damage plus an additional +1 per 5 stars, but the equipped character will attack 10% slower. It can only be equipped to Princess Bubblegum.

The Candy Duck Axe is an Uncommon weapon in Bloons Adventure Time TD. It grants the equipped character with +2 range, +0.25 per star level. As Candy Duck Axe is a Sword weapon, it can only be equipped to Finn, Dungeon Finn, and Warrior Bubblegum.

Candy Microphone is a Rare Weapon. It grants the equipped character with +3 pierce, +1 per 2 star levels. As Candy Microphone is an Instruments weapon, it can only be equipped to Jake, Tuxedo Jake, and Marceline.
Carb Bomb is a Rare Weapon. It grants the equipped character with +15% attack speed, +1% per stars.
is an Uncommon Weapon. It grants the equipped character with +3 pierce +1 per 3 stars. As is a Bomb weapon, it can only be equipped to Captain Cassie and C4 Charlie.

Cannon Ship is the third upgrade of Path 2 for the Monkey Buccaneer in Bloons TD 6. It replaces its ordinary dart attack with a powerful independent cannonball attack that shoots exploding frag bombs, producing 8 fragments per explosion once detonated, much like Bomb Shooter's Frag Bombs. Explosions deal two damage and pop up to 28 bloons (35 with 0-3-1) per shot within a blast radius of 40. Fragments deal 1 damage each, and they pop up to 1 bloon each, 2 with 0-3-1. Cannon Ship shoots bombs every 1.3s, and shoots faster with Faster Shooting's +33% attack speed (every 0.975s). Additionally, its hot burning grapes (from the Hot Shot upgrade) deal 3 damage each, and apply a burning effect that deals 2 damage per 1.5s for up to 3.0s. Like all Buccaneer upgrades, the ship can shoot cannonballs both forwards and backwards if it detects bloons behind it. Unlike BTD5, the Cannon Ship does not have automatic camo detection because Crow's Nest is now a Path 3 upgrade.

is a sub-tower that is deployed from a Carrier Flagship. Its missiles will automatically seek the strongest Blimp on screen, while its forward firing missiles obey the target priority of the main ship. There is a bug in version 48.x where they can be selected in the Review Map screen; they appear under the name "BuccaneerPlane" and look like the most recently selected non-primary tower.

Ghost Bloons are a new bloon property introduced in the 1.2 update of Bloons Adventure Time TD, much like the Camo, Regrow, Fortified, Shield, and Zombie bloon properties. Ghost Bloons distinguish themselves from normal Bloons by wearing ghostly drapes that feature sinister smiling faces, whereas MOAB-class bloons will show a full ghostly appearance over their bodies to indicate their Ghost property, as well as having a cyan-colored outline when behind an obstructing object. They make their appearance in the Hall-Ooo-Ween event and in the Frozen Blades Adventure in Ice Kingdom. They are immune to physical attacks, making weapons like darts, bombs, and swords useless against them; Only energy, bubblegum, fire, and ice attacks, or any character with trinkets like Robo-Monkey Visor or Glob's Helmet can pop Ghost Bloons. Like any property, Ghost Bloons can also be combined with other Bloon properties as well. The Ghost property can also apply to MOAB Class bloons, with the exception of DDTs and BADs; Ghost MOAB-Class Bloons have a glowing white aura (with glowing eyes for BFBs and ZOMGs) to indicate they have the Ghost property, and they slowly turn to skeletons as they take damage. Currently, Ghost MOAB-class are only available in limited time events containing Ghost Bloons, such as the 2018 Hall-Ooo-Ween event or the 2018 Holly Jolly Secrets event. They are also seen in Promcoming and Frozen Blades on certain difficulties.

In Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword, s across water tiles can now be blockaded by enemy ships. The "Blockade Mission" can only be performed by Naval Units and is most effective when performed in close proximity to an enemy city. In general, this means that the "Blockade" mission works best between players at war. The lone exception to this rule is when players use the Privateer unit, which can effectively blockade at any time. By choosing the "Blockade Mission," a Naval Unit may prevent enemy trade routes from passing through the area which they are blockading, effectively preventing enemies from gaining any gold from that route. Blockaded regions appear as large striped zones stretching outward from the unit performing the mission. If an enemy city falls within this zone, players can ensure that no overseas trade will reach this city! If a city is blockaded by a Privateer while two nations are at peace, the blockading player will receive a portion of the gold from the blockaded routes.
